Baluddin

Biography

Baluddin collects Joon antiquities. Sahilia’s theft from his house gives Zak a way to arrange a meeting with him. He says he recognised At-Zako as a living Joon before imperial scholars took the young man away. Later he was called to identify those same scholars’ mutilated bodies, a discovery that redirects the investigation toward necromancy. [1, 2]
